2609.29855.title: Multi-Task Learning by using Contextualized Word Representations for Syntactic Parsing of a Morphologically Rich Language
2609.29855.paper_summary: We address the challenge of syntactic parsing for Urdu, a morphologically rich language, and present state-of-the-art results for both constituency and dependency parsing. This paper offers four major contributions: 1) the conversion of the CLE-UTB phrase structure treebank into a dependency treebank by developing language-specific head-word and phrase-to-dependency label mapping rules; 2) a novel sequence labeling scheme that transforms the parsing task into a unified representation; 3) the training of contextualized word representations on a large 220 million tokens Urdu corpus collected from the web; and 4) development of parsing framework using two learning paradigms, single-task and multi-task learning. Several post-processing rules are applied to improve the quality of the automatically converted dependency structure treebank. The proposed sequence labeling scheme enables the use of a shared architecture that learns the syntactic structures from both grammatical structures simultaneously and hence improves generalization. Experiments show that the multi-task learning setup significantly enhances parsing performance, achieving an F1 score of 91.39 for constituency parsing (an improvement of 3.29 points) and a labeled attachment score of 85.69 for dependency parsing (an improvement of 1.49 points). These results demonstrate that learning cross-task representations provides measurable benefits and advances the state of syntactic parsing for Urdu.
2609.29855.paper_summary_zh: 我們針對烏爾都語的句法解析挑戰進行探討，這是一種形態豐富的語言，並提出了最先進的成就，涵蓋了成分解析和依賴解析。本文提供了四項主要貢獻：1）通過開發特定於語言的主詞和短語到依賴標籤的映射規則，將 CLE-UTB 短語結構樹庫轉換為依賴樹庫；2）一種新穎的序列標記方案，將解析任務轉化為統一表示；3）在從網路收集的大型 2.2 億標記的烏爾都語語料庫上訓練上下文化的詞表示；以及 4）使用單任務和多任務學習兩種學習範式開發解析框架。應用幾個後處理規則以改善自動轉換的依賴結構樹庫的質量。所提出的序列標記方案使得可以使用共享架構，從兩種語法結構中同時學習句法結構，從而提高了泛化能力。實驗顯示，多任務學習設置顯著提升了解析性能，成分解析的 F1 分數達到 91.39（提高了 3.29 點），依賴解析的標記附加分數為 85.69（提高了 1.49 點）。這些結果表明，學習跨任務表示提供了可衡量的好處，並推進了烏爾都語的句法解析狀態。
